## Missing Agent Context — `crime_00017`

The scanner flagged it: this repo ships **no** agent-readable instruction files.

- No `AGENTS.md` at root
- No `CLAUDE.md` at root
- No `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`
- No `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`
- `package.json` exposes `tsup` / `tsup-node` bins with no discoverable usage notes

**Severity:** medium, confidence 0.9, agent_risk 0.53.

### Why this matters for your first PR

An agent landing in this repo has to *infer* everything from file layout:

- Which commands run the build, the tests, the typecheck — no entrypoint hint
- Which directories are domain (`src/esbuild`, `src/rollup`, `src/plugins`) vs. fixtures (`test/`)
- Conventions around the load-bearing files the scan already surfaced (`src/plugin.ts` fan-in 10, `src/utils.ts` fan-in 18, `src/index.ts` fan-out 17) — without context, an agent will happily restructure them
- That `src/index.ts:build` and several other "safe-sounding" names actually perform side effects (False Identity findings) — easy to misuse from a wrong mental model

Result: confident-but-wrong edits. The bigger the function (and this repo has 237/293/153-line beasts), the worse the blast.

### Minimal `AGENTS.md` skeleton that clears the finding

```markdown
# AGENTS.md

Guidance for coding agents working in this repo.

## What this is
tsup — a TypeScript bundler powered by esbuild, with optional rollup
for .d.ts generation. The `tsup` and `tsup-node` binaries live in
`packages/cli`-style entrypoints under `src/cli-main.ts` and `src/index.ts`.

## Commands
- Install:    pnpm install
- Build:      pnpm build
- Test:       pnpm test
- Typecheck:  pnpm typecheck
- Lint:       pnpm lint

Run the full gate before opening a PR: `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`.

## Layout
- src/index.ts        — public API + orchestrator (`build`, `mainTasks`)
- src/cli-main.ts     — CLI argument handling
- src/esbuild/        — esbuild plugin pipeline (postcss, svelte, swc)
- src/rollup.ts       — rollup config for .d.ts bundling
- src/plugins/        — internal tsup plugins (cjs-splitting, terser, swc-target)
- src/plugin.ts       — Plugin class — load-bearing, 10 importers
- src/utils.ts        — shared helpers — load-bearing, 18 importers
- test/               — vitest suites; `test/utils.ts` is the shared harness

## Conventions
- Async I/O over sync I/O in domain code; `src/fs.ts` `*Sync` helpers
  are intentional but should not spread.
- Inject time/clock at the boundary — don't add new `Date.now()` /
  `new Date()` calls in domain code.
- Prefer extracting helpers over growing existing functions. Several
  files already exceed our 60-line domain threshold; don't add to them.

## Load-bearing files (read importers before restructuring)
- src/plugin.ts (fan-in 10)
- src/utils.ts  (fan-in 18)
- src/index.ts  (fan-out 17)
- src/log.ts    (fan-in 9)

## Safety
- Side-effectful functions with innocent-looking names: `build`,
  `buildAll`, `buildStart`, `getRollupConfig`. They mutate state /
  remove files — don't treat them as pure.
- Don't rewrite tests under `test/` to satisfy a refactor — several
  are already weak-assertion stubs; fix them deliberately, not as a
  side quest.
```

Drop that at the repo root and the `missing_agent_context` finding clears. Once you have it, swap in a `CLAUDE.md` that just `@AGENTS.md`'s it (or symlink) and the Codex / Claude / Cursor side-channels all pick up the same source of truth.
